name: CSP Lifecycle Suite
description: Complete CSP (Community Support Program) lifecycle management with broadcast visibility auditing, real-time communication feeds, and lifecycle email notifications for users and admins.

broadcastVisibilityGuard.description: Prevents stale broadcast data in user feeds with 15-second cache refresh and automatic cache invalidation on admin mutations.

visibilityDiagnostics.description: Admin dashboard showing hidden broadcast audit with reason classifications: inactive, not_broadcasting, missing_expiry, expired.

lifecycleCommunication.description: Lifecycle email notifications for CSP milestones: request submitted, broadcast live, broadcast complete, contribution processed.

communicationFeed.description: Real-time CSP communication feed in user dashboard showing request timeline and notification history.
